text: Implementing FittedLatentEncoder as a nonlinear convex-code capability separate from FittedProjection. The encoder will consume explicit one-row ObservationPattern values, compile fixed-decoder entry losses plus row ridge/L1 penalties to the portable proximal-gradient solver, report support/objective/prox-gradient residual/uniqueness and decoded predictions, and fail closed on empty support, censoring, unseen levels, foreign domains, or unsupported non-Lipschitz loss blocks.
